Based on the provided images:

1.  **Yes**, in Image 1, there is a distinct **golden/amber band of particles** (resembling a ring of dust or small dots) encircling the Earth. It appears as a **single thin, flat elliptical loop** situated in one specific orbital plane, similar to how Saturn's rings look when viewed at an angle. It is not a diffuse cloud covering the whole sphere.
2.  **Yes**, the text label **'West Ford 1963 — reconstrucción declarada (sin datos vivos)'** is visible in Image 1. It is located at the bottom of the right-hand side panel, just above the "Opacidad del shell" (Shell opacity) slider.
3.  **Yes**, in Image 2, that golden/amber particle band is completely **absent** from the visualization of the Earth.
4.  In Image 2, the label **'West Ford 1963...' is completely gone**; it no longer appears anywhere on the screen or in the side panel.
5.  There are **no visual defects**. The Earth, UI elements, and other data layers remain intact and functional in both images. The only changes are the presence/absence of the West Ford 1963 ring and its corresponding label.
